_comment: Policy as data, not as instructions an agent may reinterpret. The authority
service evaluates this; the agent does not decide what it may do.
Five dimensions, evaluated independently. The strictest applicable rule
governs, because a low-code change can be irreversible, a complex internal
change can be safe, a reversible action can still breach privacy, and a

ceilings._comment: The most autonomy ever available at each consequence class, whatever else holds.

rules.because: an external side effect does not come back because the commit did. Technical rollback and real-world reversibility are different questions.
a down path that has never been run is a down path that does not exist
autonomy is only safe where harm is detectable. Nobody finding out is not the same as nothing going wrong.
acting on evidence nobody would defend is not autonomy, it is a guess with a budget
a dashboard nobody is watching detects nothing at 3am
an action with no identity cannot be revoked, rate-limited or explained afterwards

autonomy.A1: prepare the action for a human to review
autonomy.A2: execute reversible internal actions within a narrow envelope
autonomy.A3: execute bounded external actions with strong assurance and monitoring
autonomy.A4: execute without per-action review, where consequences remain bounded
